name: Maroccosuchus
isnote: Traditionally a tomistomine, now treated as a gavialoid (English Wikipedia).
sum: Maroccosuchus is a gavialoid crocodylian from the Early Eocene of Morocco.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from Couche I and an unnamed unit in Morocco.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Jonet and Wouters 1977
